en: Black‑and‑white image of a large, ornate riverside building reflected in calm water. The multi‑storey structure has a long, symmetrical façade with many tall windows, gabled roofs, and decorative dormers in a late‑19th‑century historicist style. On the left is a tall spired section and a large hall-like wing; on the right, corner pavilions with elaborate gables and a projecting bay. A tree‑lined promenade runs between the building and the river. In the foreground a small rowboat with a person inside moves along the river. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
